import sys, json, random, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as impl
rng = random.Random(17)
svc = ['t%d'%i for i in range(16)]
specs = [tuple(rng.choice(svc) for _ in range(5)) for _ in range(10)]
req = {'services':svc,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for p in specs]}}],
       'queries':[[svc[0],svc[1]]]}
payload = json.dumps(req).encode()
pr = cProfile.Profile()
pr.enable()
for _ in range(3):
    impl.process(payload)
pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO()
pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('cumulative').print_stats(22)
print(s.getvalue())
EOF
